parameters.content:
## 🎁 FluxFilm win-back — SETUP
**Every day 11:00 India time** it asks the shop for customers whose last plan ended **15 days** ago and **30 days** ago (no active plan, not renewed, not emailed for that campaign in 60 days, not unsubscribed).
The shop makes each one a **personal one-use coupon** (only their phone, 7 days; % / ₹ set in admin → 🔗 Integrations) and gives a link that fills the coupon in.

1. Same credentials as workflow 01: `FluxFilm n8n key` (Header Auth) + `SMTP FluxFilm (Gmail app password)`.
2. Put your sender in **Send win-back email** → From.
3. **Execute workflow** once (it creates real coupons for real customers and emails them — test first with the Send Email node pointed at your own address if you want). Then **Active** on.

WhatsApp node is **disabled** (see README). Every email has an unsubscribe link (required for offers).
